description: MCP-native test infrastructure for coding agents. Submit URL + goal, get back action trail + bugs + screenshots + WebM video. 12 AI evaluation personalities (Marketing Strategist, Legal Eagle, MCP Auditor, Skeptical CTO, Consistency Auditor, etc.) with stickler-mode microcopy detection, Whole Kit combo tiers with auto-pause-on-bugs, throwaway email + SMS inboxes for OTP signups, hands-off demo-video assembly.
